notes.title: Decrypter and AI level 4
notes.notes:
[b]Decrypter[/b]
An upgrade in the later stages of the game that both captures encrypted data snippets and then decrypts them for permanent bonuses.

[b]AI Level 4[/b]
Upgrading to AI level 4 will allow the Ship AI to automatically scan new sectors when it runs out of auto-mining targets.
